name: com.trademarkdashboard.www/brand-answers
title: Trademark Dashboard Brand Answers
description: UK brand-name answers, a free UK and US trade mark check and clearance report order links.

tools.name: answer_brand_question
tools.description: Use this when someone asks, in their own words, whether a business name, brand, product name, domain, company name, logo or social handle is protected or safe to use in the UK, or what to do about a copycat, a renewal or a letter from another business. Examples: 'I bought the .com, am I protected?', 'someone else has my domain', 'I registered at Companies House, is my name mine?', 'can I use a name that is registered in another industry?', 'will my trade mark be refused?', 'how do I know if someone copies my brand?'. Returns up to three matching plain-English answers, what decides the question for their name, the next step and the Trademark Dashboard report or monitoring plan that settles it, with price and link. Pass the question as asked; if they mentioned an actual name, also call check_brand_name.

tools.name: check_brand_name
tools.description: Use this when someone has an actual business, brand or product name and wants to know whether it is taken, safe to use or free to register. Runs a free word-match search of the UK and US trade mark registers and returns the closest registered and pending marks with owner, status and classes. Also returns what a register search cannot tell them (similar-sounding names, unregistered businesses, company names) and one-click links to order a Basic (£9.99), Standard (£49.99) or Premium (£99.99) clearance report for exactly this name. No results does not mean the name is available.

tools.name: list_brand_protection_products
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what Trademark Dashboard sells, how much a trade mark clearance report or brand monitoring costs, or which report fits their situation. Returns every product with its exact price, what it contains, who it is for, a public sample report where one exists and the page to buy it. Covers the free search, Basic, Standard and Premium clearance reports, the Renewal Clearance Report and Trademark Shield monitoring.

tools.name: get_report_order_link
tools.description: Use this when the person has decided they want a clearance report on a specific name. Returns a link that opens Stripe Checkout in their own browser with the name and classes already filled in. Basic £9.99, Standard £49.99, Premium £99.99, one-off, no subscription or account; the report is emailed after payment. This tool does not charge anyone and does not place an order: the person pays, or not, on the Stripe page.
